summary: Viewed all four supplied PNGs, including the native 1x cells and nearest 3x previews on light, dark and checker backgrounds. The low brown body, short tail, pale facial marking, black nose and clustered moss remain readable at 1x. Broad upper-left highlights and darker belly/limbs give the body volume; the moss has its own green shading. Near and far legs separate, although the far foreleg is slender and the face reads mostly in profile. No obvious broken body outline, unintended transparent body holes or detached paws are visible. Windup lowers the back and head; move extends the rear leg; attack places a broader connected forepaw forward; recover lifts it again. These are modest but readable changes with consistent body mass and face placement. Planted feet share the ground line; the raised rear foot in move reads as a stride. Skill preparation raises a glowing paw, contact connects three earthen spikes to the paw's ground contact, and recovery lifts the paw among breaking fragments. Poison has a crouched, paw-to-mouth posture and bubbles; stun lowers the head with a closed eye and stars; sleep folds the limbs beneath a rounded resting body with a closed eye. These states change pixel geometry rather than merely tinting the idle. The flattened dead pose is distinguishable from sleep. This is a visual recommendation for user consideration, not a selection. Static previews cannot establish playback timing, actual battle contact, palette/alpha compliance or the claimed authorship process.
